tasks.label: check: all
tasks.detail: Pre-merge checks (CI runs the same): versions, CHANGELOG, cargo test, guide.js + static generator host tests, scripts parse.

tasks.label: build: player + daemon
tasks.detail: sljf-play + sljfd for the Link with the Steam Link SDK -> out/

tasks.label: build: on-TV app
tasks.detail: sljf-ui + QML + theme with the Steam Link SDK -> out/app/jellyfin/

tasks.label: build: all
tasks.detail: Player, daemon and the on-TV app -> out/

tasks.label: render: app screenshot
tasks.detail: Screenshot of the built app (out/app/jellyfin) offscreen at 1280x720 -> out/shot.png; talks to sljfd through an ssh tunnel on :8097

tasks.label: deploy: to the Link
tasks.detail: Copies out/ (player, daemon, app if built) to the Steam Link and restarts sljfd (asks first)
